stories.story_fr: Le carnet de commandes RPO bondit a 553 Md$, en hausse de 325% sur un an, porte par d'enormes contrats IA dont le financement des GPU est largement prepaye par les clients.
stories.story_en: RPO backlog jumped to $553 billion, up 325% year-over-year, driven by large-scale AI contracts where customers largely prepay or supply the GPUs.
stories.quote: Remaining Performance Obligations, or RPO, ended the quarter at $553 billion, up 325% from last year and up $29 billion from last quarter. Most of the increase in RPO in Q3 related to large scale AI contracts

stories.story_fr: Le revenu Cloud Infrastructure (IaaS) accelere a 4,9 Md$, +84% sur un an, surpassant le rythme de croissance des hyperscalers concurrents sur la demande IA.
stories.story_en: Cloud Infrastructure (IaaS) revenue accelerated to $4.9 billion, up 84% year-over-year, outpacing rival hyperscalers on AI demand.
stories.quote: Q3 Cloud Infrastructure Revenue (IaaS) $4.9 billion, up 84% in USD and up 81% in constant currency

stories.story_fr: Le revenu Multicloud Database (Amazon, Google, Microsoft) explose de 531% sur un an au T3 26 et reste la branche la plus dynamique d'Oracle, apres +817% au trimestre precedent.
stories.story_en: Multicloud Database revenue (Amazon, Google, Microsoft) surged 531% year-over-year in Q3 26 and remains Oracle's fastest-growing business, after +817% the prior quarter.
stories.quote: Q3 Oracle Cloud Database (IaaS) Revenue up 35%, Multicloud Database Revenue up 531% in USD

stories.story_fr: Oracle cede sa participation dans le fabricant de puces Ampere pour un gain de 2,7 Md$ avant impots et adopte une politique de neutralite des puces avec ses fournisseurs CPU et GPU.
stories.story_en: Oracle sold its stake in chipmaker Ampere for a $2.7 billion pre-tax gain and adopted a chip-neutrality policy across its CPU and GPU suppliers.
stories.quote: a $2.7 billion pre-tax gain in the sale of Oracle's interest in our Ampere chip company

stories.story_fr: Oracle restructure ses equipes de developpement en groupes plus petits grace a la generation de code par IA, produisant plus de logiciels en moins de temps avec moins de personnel.
stories.story_en: Oracle is restructuring its development teams into smaller groups using AI code generation, building more software in less time with fewer people.
stories.quote: This new AI Code Generation technology is enabling us to build more software in less time with fewer people.
